title: Core normalized coefficient sections package
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E and scheme W, a coefficient reduction R and finite tensor normalization hF determine a nonempty core package consisting of scalar coherence, derived tower-section evaluation, the prescribed total-limit comparison and its resolution equation, and the actual finite projection equation. The package omits only the H-zero scalar Hom normalization.

source.place: Tags 03CZ, 079P, 08JA, 0D6E and 0941; extracted construction steps 1--2 of the normalized coefficient-sections package.

proof.text: Apply the normalized sequence global-sections evaluation theorem to the completed coefficient ring and its quotient tower. Transport the resulting scalar comparisons, finite evaluations and universal derived comparison through the prescribed coefficient functors. Apply the simultaneous sections/limit comparison theorem and identify its ordinary and derived projections with the recorded coefficient comparisons. The resulting data are exactly the fields of the core package.

proof_origin.place: Extracted core of the normalized coefficient-sections construction.

from.place: Strictly smaller package omitting the H-zero scalar field.
